build: cargo build --release --bin umber --example layout --example layout_allocations; default features, fat LTO, codegen-units=1

format.resource_policy: All loaded plain font instances and their exact 47 used TFM resources are embedded; Gentle new sizes use those embedded resources. Loading executes no plain source.

prepared_replay.validation: complete output and retained prefixes/results equal

endpoints.whole_process: Fresh process: executable startup, host file reads, source bootstrap or binary decode, full document, output and teardown. Umber retains detached pages; native writes DVI/log. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH fixes native date; explicitcalendar fixes Umber. No Callgrind/instrumentation or concurrent builds.
endpoints.empty_job: Same startup paths ending immediately with end. Includes process/I/O/bootstrap/decode/teardown, not a pure decoder microbenchmark. Source empty job parses unchanged plain; own/native format jobs load their artifacts.
endpoints.prepared: Existing adapter: host bundle/image read before timers; reference.engine_setup_ns is one in-memory decode+startup sample. READY is before everyjob, then10/49/88-page checkpoints. Capture/restore/replay samples are separate from fresh process timings.
endpoints.rss: Independent GNU time -f %M fresh runs, KiB Linux peakRSS, three samples, separate from CPU samples. Prepared allocation accounting retains independent reference/output/checkpoints; not cold single-engineRSS.
endpoints.sampling: One warmup per endpoint per case, seven alternating serial pairs pinnedCPU3, warm filesystem caches; short shared-host measurements, no cold-cache/general performance claim.
endpoints.native_resources: Existing native format plus normal immutable TeX Live lookup paths; Gentle reads cmr10/cmbx10 for new sizes. Umber uses embedded raw TFMs and receives zero extra mappings. Both use the same original resource bytes.

measurement_driver.uses: existing benchmarks/layout.py child/rss and benchmarks/gentle.py DVI helpers
